Class WayangAssistantApi

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.assistant.api.WayangAssistantApi
@Path("/api/v1/assistant") @PermitAll @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class WayangAssistantApi extends Object
REST API for the Wayang Internal Assistant.

Endpoints

  • POST /api/v1/assistant/ask – single Q&A
  • POST /api/v1/assistant/chat – multi-turn chat (sends/receives a sessionId)
  • GET /api/v1/assistant/chat/{sid}/history – conversation history
  • DELETE /api/v1/assistant/chat/{sid} – clear a session
  • POST /api/v1/assistant/generate-project – project generation from intent
  • POST /api/v1/assistant/troubleshoot – error troubleshooting
  • GET /api/v1/assistant/capabilities – feature manifest
  • GET /api/v1/assistant/knowledge-sources – list of registered knowledge sources
  • POST /api/v1/assistant/suggestions – contextual design suggestions
